supplied_evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L23: For the fiscal 2027 first quarter, revenues of $14.1 million increased $0.4 million, or 3%, as compared to the prior year period. This primarily reflected higher revenues from league distributions of $1.2 million, mainly due to an increase in certain league distributions unrelated to national media rights fees, partially offset by other revenue decreases.
supplied_evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L25: Selling, general and administrative expenses of $28.1 million increased $5.8 million, or 26%, as compared to the prior year period. This increase was primarily driven by (i) expenses related to the spin-off transaction in the current year period of $3.6 million and (ii) higher employee compensation and related benefits of $1.4 million.
supplied_evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L26: Operating loss of $23.6 million increased $10.7 million and adjusted operating loss of $21.3 million increased $10.9 million, both as compared to the prior year period, primarily due to higher selling, general and administrative expenses and direct operating expenses.
